CFML Language Reference: Functions

Len

Returns the number of characters in a string, or the number of bytes in a binary object.

Category

String functions

Syntax

Len(string_or_binary)

Parameters

string_or_binary
A string, or a binary object such as one returned by ToBinary or CFFILE ACTION="ReadBinary".

Returns

The length as a number; 0 for an empty string.

Usage

Len(Trim(Form.Name)) is the standard way to make sure a form field contains more than just spaces. In a CFIF, a non-zero length counts as true, so <CFIF Len(Form.Name)> works too.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFPARAM NAME="URL.Word" DEFAULT="Supercalifragilistic">
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>"#URL.Word#" has #Len(URL.Word)# characters.</P>
<P>With spaces around it: #Len("  padded  ")#; trimmed: #Len(Trim("  padded  "))#</P>
<P>A binary object made from "KoldFusion" is #Len(ToBinary(ToBase64("KoldFusion")))# bytes long.</P>
</CFOUTPUT>
<FORM ACTION="len.cfm" METHOD="GET">
Try a word: <INPUT TYPE="Text" NAME="Word"> <INPUT TYPE="Submit" VALUE="Count">
</FORM>
